Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing for multiple patents on next-generation wireless communication is a high-stakes move designed to secure a temporary monopoly. This will likely impede our development efforts by creating legal barriers to entry, forcing us to either seek alternative technological solutions or engage in costly licensing negotiations. The market impact includes potential delays in our product roadmap and increased R&D costs, while the broader implication is a shift in competitive dynamics where Theta can dictate terms or slow our market entry.

A book is primarily made of paper.
